t: Veralto's Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Sales & Margins
desc: Veralto Corporation (VLTO) delivered impressive Q3 2026 results with adjusted EPS of $1.18 (up 19.2% y/y) and revenues of $1.51 billion (up 7.5% y/y), both beating consensus estimates. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $4.49-$4.52 and core sales growth outlook to 4.2-4.5%. Water Quality segment drove growth with 9.8% revenue increase, while adjusted operating margins expanded 170 basis points to 25.6% due to operational improvements and cost optimization.
